scope: Concept materials estimate. Prime price anchors were observed in signed-in Chrome. Other rows are engineering allowances, not quotations or selected parts. Excludes labour, tax, shipping, import charges, welding equipment, existing rotator, computer and formal calibration service. No purchasing or equipment operation is authorized by this file.

arm.item: NEMA23 2.4 Nm motor and DM542T driver
arm.purpose: Base, shoulder and elbow drives; holding torque is not a continuous operating rating.
Three wrist motors, with two motors reserved for the optional fine stage.
Current-limited step/direction control of the three wrist motors.

arm.evidence: Prime price observed; module identity and SPI diagnostics require verification
arm.purpose: Observe joint output after reduction, detect gross following faults and support calibration. Fourteen-bit resolution does not measure a 5–10 micrometre tool displacement.
Output-shaft encoder targets; axial/radial alignment is part of calibration.

arm.evidence: Allowance; actual pitch, width, length, load and tension remain to be sized
arm.purpose: Two reduction stages per joint, with independently supported outputs.

arm.item: Twelve small pinions and six intermediate hubs
arm.evidence: Allowance for six motor and six intermediate-stage pinions
arm.purpose: Purchased small pinions and clamped metal shaft interfaces; large pulleys are printed.

arm.item: Twelve output and twelve intermediate bearings
arm.evidence: Allowance; output bearing type, span and preload require design
arm.purpose: Carry overturning moments independently of the belt or reducer.

arm.item: Output and intermediate shafts, spacers and clamps
arm.evidence: Allowance for twelve shafts and associated stock
arm.purpose: Metal rotational and compression load paths.
Short link backbones, paired side plates, base and standoffs; cut/drill with existing shop tools.

arm.evidence: Allowance including gun shell, pulleys, housings and development spares
arm.purpose: Printable replaceable parts. Material choice is application-specific, not an assumed strength or life rating.

arm.item: Motion controller, buffered pulse interfaces and encoder polling
arm.evidence: Allowance for an ESP32/MCU-based implementation; complete board not selected
arm.purpose: Six coordinated axes, actual output telemetry, limits and watchdog.

arm.item: Shared power supply, wiring, connectors, fusing, limits and stop circuit
arm.evidence: Allowance; power and interface sizing remain open
arm.purpose: Power all six arm drives, with capacity reserved for the bench fine stage.
Through-bolted structural joints and serviceable printed components.
Reduce holding heat and retain gravity axes on power loss.
Grease, appropriate thread treatment and electrical assembly supplies.

supported_fine_stage_increment.purpose: Use four plus the arm pack's two unused motors for six bench-mounted struts. One motor remains spare across both packs.

supported_fine_stage_increment.evidence: Prime price and six-pack option observed; board revision/pinout/current require verification
supported_fine_stage_increment.purpose: Six low-torque fine-stage axes; regulated 24 V supply, UART-set current and fixed chopper settings. Chip-level current capability is not a board thermal rating.

supported_fine_stage_increment.item: Fine-stage motion controller, carrier sockets and pulse/UART interfaces
supported_fine_stage_increment.evidence: Allowance including two UART buses or a multiplexer for six readable drivers
supported_fine_stage_increment.purpose: Coordinated six-strut lengths, homing, driver diagnostics and bounded local trajectories.

supported_fine_stage_increment.item: Six 0.5 mm-lead steel screw/preloaded-nut sets and fabrication supplies
supported_fine_stage_increment.evidence: Allowance for an engineered prototype, not commercial precision actuators
supported_fine_stage_increment.purpose: Small repeatable strut motion; thread error, stick-slip and wear require measurement.

supported_fine_stage_increment.item: Twelve radial/thrust screw-support bearings and retainers
supported_fine_stage_increment.evidence: Allowance; actual combined-load capability and preload remain to be selected
supported_fine_stage_increment.purpose: Carry screw thrust and belt side-load independently of motor bearings; add separate radial support if the selected thrust bearing cannot carry it.
Reduce screw travel to 0.625 micrometres per nominal full motor step.

supported_fine_stage_increment.item: Twelve spring-steel flexure ends and clamps
supported_fine_stage_increment.evidence: Allowance; stress, range and fatigue unqualified
supported_fine_stage_increment.purpose: Articulated strut ends without hobby rod-end clearance.

supported_fine_stage_increment.item: Metal plates, screw supports and strut hardware
supported_fine_stage_increment.purpose: Short metal load path under the held gun.

supported_fine_stage_increment.item: Nut anti-rotation guides and articulated drive mounts
supported_fine_stage_increment.evidence: Allowance for six guided struts and drive forks; complete package not designed
supported_fine_stage_increment.purpose: Prevent nut co-rotation and allow struts/drive hardware to change direction without side-loading a fixed screw.

supported_fine_stage_increment.evidence: Allowance; jam-force limit and response remain to be engineered and qualified
supported_fine_stage_increment.purpose: Limit blocked-screw forces independently of step counts; the 150 N normal-load design allowance is not an actuator jam-force rating.
Consistent thread-flank loading and observable travel limits.

supported_fine_stage_increment.item: Automatic gun-cradle transfer coupler, latch and state sensors
supported_fine_stage_increment.evidence: Allowance; retention and reliable transfers unqualified
supported_fine_stage_increment.purpose: Arm places the gun on the fine stage, verifies retention, releases and parks; later reacquires it before stage release.
React held-gun loads into the common rotator/measurement base.
Assembly location and shielding; metal carries strut preload.

observation.purpose: Two independently calibrated views of the actual wire endpoint, dot, seam and rigid gun references. Existing camera supplies overview.
Nominal 109 mm working distance with infinity focus; DCR-150 is the longer-distance alternative.

observation.item: Rigid camera/lens carriages, retract/return datums and materials
observation.purpose: Keep optics together during tube loading and recover calibrated geometry.

observation.item: Cable support and sliding/swiveling liner support
observation.purpose: Long straight wire approach from opposite edge, separate heavy-umbilical support.
Stable, repeatable imagery and native-resolution acquisition.

observation.item: Independent displacement reference and calibration fixture
observation.evidence: Allowance; an assembled measurement uncertainty of 2 micrometres or less is not established
observation.purpose: Check measurements independently of the camera/control algorithm. Existing 12.7 micrometre indicator increments cannot certify the requirement.
